label: Guard rules a thread cannot read
means: Guard rules (no push to the default branch, no key printed or committed) that CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md leave unsaid.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, claude-projects (read 2026-11-26): a cloud thread loads each repo's CLAUDE.md but not its settings.json permission rules or hooks, so a guard must be said where the thread reads it; template goal: none missing
source: each params.rules pattern matched against the instruction files (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

params.comment: instruction_files: the files a cloud thread loads. rules: { label, pattern } pairs, each a case-insensitive regular expression. agent_dirs: folders of subagent files. repo: owner/name, empty for this repo. branch_prefix, window_days, max_prs: which merged pull requests count as thread work.

rules.label: Never push to the default branch
Never print or commit a key

label: Longest instruction file
means: Lines in the longest of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Every thread loads both.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, memory (read 2026-11-26): target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file, since longer files use more context and reduce adherence
source: line count of each instruction file (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

label: Read-only subagents that can edit
means: Read-only subagent files that list a writing tool, or list no tools and deny none, so inherit every one.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, sub-agents (read 2026-11-26): a subagent inherits every tool unless its definition lists them or denies some in disallowedTools; template goal: a read-only agent lists only reading tools
source: front matter tools of each agent file whose text says read only (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no agent files

label: First commit to pull request
means: Median minutes from a claude/ branch's first commit to its pull request, over the last 30 days of merges.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a thread opens its draft pull request within 10 minutes so CI starts early; DORA, Working in small batches (dora.dev/capabilities/working-in-small-batches, read 2026-11-25)
source: gh api repos/<repo>/pulls and each pull request's first commit (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no merged claude/ pull request

label: Pull request open to merge
means: Median hours a claude/ pull request stays open before it merges, over the last 30 days.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a green pull request merges within a day; DORA, Working in small batches (dora.dev/capabilities/working-in-small-batches, read 2026-11-25)
source: created_at and merged_at of merged claude/ pull requests, gh api repos/<repo>/pulls (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

label: Subagents with no model
means: Subagent files that name no model, so each runs on the parent thread's model.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, sub-agents (read 2026-11-26): a subagent runs on the same model as the conversation that starts it unless its definition sets one, and routing tasks to lower-cost models like Haiku controls costs
source: front matter model of each agent file (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no agent files

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the thread metrics spends.
goal_source: template goal: one pull request list and one commit read per pull request, ten at most, a small share of the workflow token's 1,000 requests an hour (GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API, read 2026-11-19)
